summary: Export portable signed agent and mission rename proofs and verify them offline against an explicit fleet anchor

replay.detail: Existing rename claims, immutable subjects, projections and naming revision tokens are unchanged.

schema.detail: Adds portable JSON schemas fractal.rename-proof.v1 and fractal.rename-proof-verdict.v1. No storage schema migration or claim-kind change.

rules.detail: Offline verification authenticates exact sealed envelopes, claim signatures, anchor-rooted membership windows, declarations and rename linkage. Only the caller-supplied fleet anchor is trusted; absent or equal-head after-revision tokens are stale.

compatibility.detail: Adds agents and missions rename-id proof export/verify. Revision arguments remain signed claim-ID tokens rather than integers. Export requires retained signed writer prefixes and fails closed for missing or unsigned evidence. Existing rename and replication behavior is preserved.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: Supply an independently authenticated fleet anchor when verifying. Export requires --include-co-batched-claims consent: bundles are fleet-internal and contain complete co-batched claims and blobs; do not publish or attach them to public issues. Pin an earlier revision with after-revision when progress is required; proofs do not assert global latestness.

recovery.detail: Verification is offline and does not mutate a store. Export seals outstanding real local batches; binary rollback requires no proof-specific data migration.
